pageDescription: Your admin tools, gathered in one place.
noAccess: You do not have access to this page.

capabilities.title: What you can do
capabilities.supportInbox: Read and reply to support requests, assign requests to yourself, and close or reopen threads
capabilities.supportAttachments: See images that users attach in the support chat
capabilities.directMessage: Send a direct message to an individual user
capabilities.preview: Try the app as a new user in a sandbox, without touching your own data
capabilities.freeView: See the app as a free user to check what is locked
capabilities.superAdminNote: As a super admin you can also:
capabilities.grantPremium: Grant free premium to a user and see their full subscription history
capabilities.broadcast: Send launch notices and messages to all users

support.title: Support
support.description: The inbox of user requests. Opens in its own view because the threads need the full screen.

premium.title: Premium
premium.description: Search for a user to see their subscription history and grant free premium. The reason you enter is saved to the history.
